        <name>IllumioMIDLogPush</name>
        <operation_script><![CDATA[(function process( /*RESTAPIRequest*/ request, /*RESTAPIResponse*/ response) {

    // W5: the MID Server's log sink.
    //
    // The MID writes with ms.log(), which lands in agent0.log on the MID host -- the one sink
    // nobody debugging from the instance can reach. This endpoint is how an error raised out
    // there ends up in Application Logs next to the server-side lines that surround it, so one
    // filtered view shows both halves of a run in order.
    //
    // It touches NO GlideRecord, on purpose and not for want of a use. The cross-scope 500 that
    // killed UpdateLabelDimensionsValue came out of record access from an inbound call, and a
    // sink that cannot fail that way is worth more than one that could store a richer payload.
    // Everything here is gs.error / gs.warn and nothing else. Keep it that way.
    //
    // Messages arrive already carrying their correlation prefix -- `[<job>][MID.<Component>] ` --
    // built by IllumioLogUtil.line(). They are emitted verbatim so that the retrieval filter
    // `message STARTSWITH "[<job sys_id>]"` finds MID and server lines together. Do not prepend
    // anything here: the job sys_id has to stay first.

    // Bounded independently of anything the MID does. IllumioLogUtil sends one line per request
    // (two on the push that announces its budget is spent), so our own client never approaches
    // this -- but the endpoint is reachable by anything that can authenticate, and one gs.error
    // per element means the request size alone decides how much work it does. The cap stays.
    var MAX_LINES = 500;

    var result = {
        accepted: 0,
        rejected: 0
    };

    var body = request.body && request.body.data ? request.body.data : null;
    var lines = body ? body.lines : null;

    // Duck-typed on purpose. This was `lines instanceof Array` and it rejected every MID push
    // with a 400 on 2026-09-29: request.body.data is parsed outside this script's realm, so the
    // array handed back is not an instance of *this* scope's Array constructor and instanceof
    // is false for a perfectly well-formed body. Array.isArray() would also survive that, but a
    // length check cannot be defeated by a realm boundary at all. The string exclusion has to
    // come first -- strings have a numeric length too.
    if (!lines || typeof lines === 'string' || typeof lines.length !== 'number') {
        response.setStatus(400);
        response.setBody({
            accepted: 0,
            rejected: 0,
            error: 'Expected a body of the form { "lines": [ { "level": "error|warn", "message": "..." } ] }'
        });

        // The caller cannot see that response body -- IllumioHTTPClient reports the status code
        // and nothing else, so a rejection is invisible from agent0.log beyond "status: 400".
        // Leave the shape that actually arrived where someone debugging from the instance can
        // find it, next to the run's other lines.
        gs.warn('[-][APP.IllumioMIDLogPush] Rejected a push. body=' +
            (body === null || body === undefined ? String(body) : typeof body) + ' lines=' +
            (lines === null || lines === undefined ? String(lines) : typeof lines) + '.');
        return;
    }

    var count = lines.length > MAX_LINES ? MAX_LINES : lines.length;

    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        var entry = lines[i];
        if (!entry || gs.nil(entry.message)) {
            result.rejected++;
            continue;
        }

        // Anything that is not explicitly a warning or a boundary line is logged as an error.
        // The MID only ever sends these three levels, and a level that arrived garbled is better
        // loud than dropped.
        if (entry.level === 'warn') {
            gs.warn(String(entry.message));
        } else if (entry.level === 'info') {
            // W6 boundary lines only. IllumioLogUtil does not push ordinary info.
            gs.info(String(entry.message));
        } else {
            gs.error(String(entry.message));
        }
        result.accepted++;
    }

    if (lines.length > count) {
        var discarded = lines.length - count;
        result.rejected += discarded;
        gs.warn('[-][APP.IllumioMIDLogPush] Log push carried ' + lines.length +
            ' line(s); ' + discarded + ' over the ' + MAX_LINES +
            ' line cap were discarded. Those lines remain in agent0.log on the MID host.');
    }

    response.setStatus(200);
    response.setBody(result);

})(request, response);
]]></operation_script>
